crossRefs.note: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought…
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you…
because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God; for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t…
crossRefs.keyword: went presumptuously up. Heb. ye were presumptuous and wentup

translations.web: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.
translations.bsb: So I spoke to you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the command of the LORD and presumptuously went up into the hill country.
translations.kjv: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
translations.asv: So I spake unto you, and ye hearkened not; but ye rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill-country.
